Commentary.Commentary: West Indies were pretty disciplined yesterday but today they were off radar. Roston Chase took 4 wickets, while Jason Holder got three to his name. Devendra Bishoo towards the end got two as well. Shannon Gabriel was the only one who went wicketless. The home side now needs to bat big if it is to deny Pakistan from running away with the game. The new ball will be crucial now. Let's see how the second innings pans out. Stay tuned...

Pakistan have racked up a pretty good score on the board! The top order in the name of Azhar Ali and Babar Azam gave them the start. The former registered his ton, while the latter scored a fifty, and then it was their skipper who did the hard work today morning. Misbah-ul-Haq after digging and tiring out the bowlers fell at the stroke of tea after making a half century himself and it seemed like the hosts would wrap it up. But, then came Sarfraz Ahmed and he kept the reputation of Mr.Dependable afloat. He toyed with the bowlers and at the same time kept nudging around to frustrate the hosts further.

OUT! Stumped! Bishoo pushes it a bit quicker through the air outside off, Mohammad Abbas dances down the track to take Bishoo on. The ball turns away and the batsman fails to connect. Dowrich behind the stumps whips the bails off. They refer it upstairs and replays show Abbas' back leg was in the air when the bails were dislodged. PAKISTAN BOWLED OUT FOR 376!
A stumping appeal against Mohammad Abbas is referred upstairs. It looks close.
Turns further after landing, Abbas doesn't fiddle with it.
Leg break outside off, Abbas leaves it for Shane.

FOUR MORE! Short of a length ball, well outside off, Hasan Ali fetches it from outside off and pulls it in front of square on the leg side. Pretty awkward shot that but it has enough legs to reach the fence.
FOUR! That's thumped! Fuller length ball on off, Hasan Ali goes bang over Gabriel's head and picks up a boundary. That's some way to get off the mark in Test cricket!
Fires it down the leg side, Ali can't flick it away. Dowrich dives to his left to stop some runs for his side.
Good length delivery, it nips back in as Hasan Ali tries to slog it across the line. Misses and the ball goes off the pads and over the stumps to first slip who collects it on one bounce.
Wrong line! Strays down the leg side, Abbas after seeing Sarfraz batting, doesn't miss out. Helps it off his hips down to fine leg for a single.
Angles in a length ball, a mistimed punch back to Shannon.
Quicker one around off, Ali lunges forward to defend but does so a bit uppishly as the ball goes wide of the silly point fielder.
The debutant, Hasan Ali makes his way to the middle.

OUT! Edged and taken! Sarfraz Ahmed has to walk back but, but not before playing a handful knock! Bishoo gives it a bit more flight and serves it outside off, Sarfraz Ahmed makes room to go inside out over extra cover but the ball turns away, takes the outside edge and flies towards Shai Hope at first slip who gobbles it down. West Indies finally manage to break this stand.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards mid off for a brisk single.
Short and it spins away, Abbas looks to cut it away but gets beaten by the away turn.
Pushed quicker through the air around middle, Mohmmad keeps it out.
Turns away from a length outside off, Abbas gets back and cuts it straight towards the cover fielder.
Drinks are on the field!
Touch fuller, it's on a driveable length. Ahmed does so but couldn't pierce the gap. It goes straight to Chase at short cover and Sarfraz shakes his head as he wanted to keep strike.

Chance of a run out! Fuller in length and angling in, Ahmed comes forward and pushes it down to mid on. Initially he calls for the single to which Abbas responds but seeing that the fielder is quick to the ball he shouts NAHI! NAHI! NAHI! It means NO! And sends him back. However, the shy was made at the striker's end and the Pakistan wicketkeeper quickly gets back in time.
On a length and served a bit wide outside off, Abbas pushes it away towards point and Sarfraz calls him for the single.
No ball! Bangs in a short ball on middle, Mohammad Abbas ducks to let that one sail over him to the keeper. Gabriel oversteps yet again which means he'll have to reload it.
Shortish outside off, Sarfraz places it to deep backward point for a single. Ahmed wanted to come back but the fielder is quick to deny them. Can Abbas survive?
Angling in from outside off, Ahmed defends it down with a straight bat.
Shannon Gabriel is back on! Can he get a breakthrough?
Touch short and outside off, Ahmed punches it but finds the man at short cover.
Another one on the fuller side, defended with the full face of the bat.
Rock solid in defense as Mohammad Abbas leans ahead and keeps bat and pad close together to see it out.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and defends.
Outside off, on a length, it's played to point.
13th Test fifty for Sarfraz Ahmed!

Fifty for Sarfraz! He's injected some much-needed energy into this game, challenged the fielders and bowlers alike. It's been a fine knock from him. He punches it down the ground from his crease and picks up a single to complete the milestone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Devendra Bishoo to bowl again.
Short ball to Abbas which he easily evades.

Almost a yorker around off, Sarfraz Ahmed steers it past first slip. Yells at Abbas as he's crossing over to come back for the third. The slip fielder chases the ball down and throws it back in to the keeper. It's not as accurate so the batsmen are able to complete it with ease in the end.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Low full toss around off, Sarfraz crouches quite low and with an open face, squeezes it out to first slip on the bounce.
Fuller ball on middle and off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Length delivery around off, cut away to the point fielder.
Pushes this through the covers and Sarfraz instantly knows he wants the third. Runs hard and is able to come back for the third one. Superb, he's protecting the tailender extremely well here.
Stays within his crease and works it to the mid-wicket region.
Loopy on a full length, too full, it's driven to the mid on fielder.
FOUR! Superb shot. Sarfraz makes room for himself again and gets the cut shot away beautifully. Beats the man at covers and sends it across the rope.
Full on the stumps this time, it's driven down to mid on. Dot ball.
Some decent air on this as Chase lands this on a length, coming into the batsman as he backs away to cut it on the off side.
Another one outside off, shaping away as it's left alone.
Outside off on a good length, no shot offered to that one.
Good length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Abbas leans a touch ahead and defends.
Outside off on a length, Sarfraz taps it in front of covers and hares across. There is a shy at the bowler's end but it's well wide. The run is completed.
Slightly ahead of a length and around off, Ahmed keeps it out off the front foot.
Slower back of a length delivery on leg, Sarfraz makes room once more and cuts it over wide first slip to third man. Doesn't take the run though. Wants to keep the majority of the strike.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on for a brisk single.

Not out! Darts it full on middle and off, Sarfraz gets low to sweep but it's a little too full for him to do that. Is rapped on the pads and an appeal goes up, which the umpire turns down. Chase asks his skipper for the review and he takes it. It goes upstairs and replays show the ball took some part of the inside edge before hitting the pads. Easy decision to make.
An lbw appeal against Sarfraz Ahmed is reviewed by West Indies.
Loopy delivery turning in on leg, Sarfraz Ahmed backs away and cracks it towards Jason Holder at covers.
Ahmed makes room, the bowler follows him but it's too far down. Goes past the batsman and into the keeper's gloves.
Some decent flight on this, it's driven to mid off.
Excellent delivery and equally well played by Abbas. It's a yorker on off, dug out on the off side.
Angling in on leg, Abbas attempts to flick but it goes off his pads on the leg side.
Drops this length ball in front Hetmyer at cover-point and the batsmen take off. There is a shy at the striker's end which misses. Would have been close had that hit.
Just back of a length outside off, stays behind the line and blocks it out.
Makes room for himself but the bowler follows him. It's on the body as Ahmed glances it through backward square leg. Immediately calls for the second and he gets it. Good stuff.

FOUR! That's gone off the top edge but this is a good, aggressive approach from Sarfraz Ahmed. It's angling in on leg, he makes room to slog it over the leg side. It goes off the edge and flies over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Alzarri Joseph is back on to bowl.
From around the wicket, short and rising on the batsman, he however does well to go back and keep it down in front of short leg.
Full on the stumps, swept through the square leg area for a single.
Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for the batsman.
Once again he backs away, it's a low full toss on off which is carved away through the gap in the off side for a couple of runs.
Sarfraz is standing showing all three stumps, Chase follows him with a full ball on his toes, it's kept out.
Loopy and dropped just back of a driving length, Sarfraz gives the charge and slogs it off the inner half. No run taken.
Holder serves a full ball on off, Abbas does well to keep it at bay.
This time he will get a run! On the pads, easy flick behind square on the leg side for a single.
Angles in a length ball on off, Ahmed pushes it towards covers, wants the single but won't get it.
FOUR! Short of a length delivery outside off, Sarfraz Ahmed waits for it and then ramps it beautifully over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Fuller in length on off, defended off the front foot.

Just over first slip! Shortish delivery, which comes slowly off the deck on leg. Ahmed waits and waits for it before going for the pull. The ball bounces a bit more, takes his gloves and goes over a leaping Powell at first slip. The ball runs behind and they take two.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Ahmed eases it down to long on for a single.

Stumping chance missed! An lovely off break, which turns in sharply as Abbas goes for a big heave across the line. Gets beaten by the sharp turn and Dowrich behind the stumps fails to collect it cleanly. The ball deflects off the keeper's gloves and they sneak a bye. Chase will have to wait for a 5-fer.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Short and outside off, Sarfraz backs away and cuts it past point for one.
Floated ball outside off, driven towards the off side.
Shortish on middle, MA ducks under it.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards covers by Ahmed. He wants the single and there is a shy at the bowler's end but it misses. A single taken.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Leg bye! Strays down the leg side, Abbas misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Shuffles a touch and nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed towards gully.
The ball turns in, Abbas looks to tuck it away but the ball bounces a bit and hits him on the thigh pad.
Lunges forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Turns in from a length on off, worked towards FSL.
Sarfraz makes room and exposes the stumps, Chase fires it flatter outside off, it's slapped through covers for a single.
Drifting down leg, Ahmed leaves it alone.
Full and around off, Ahmed driven towards covers.
Short and angling in on the body, Abbas is happy to sit under it.
Fuller in length on off, defended off the front foot towards covers.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Abbas gets behind the line to defend.
Pitches it up this time on middle, defended in front of short leg.
Short of a length outside off, Abbas has got nothing to offer.
A well-directed short ball, Abbas sits under the bumper.
Quicker one on the stumps, worked just past the man at short fine leg for a single. But why would they take the single on the final ball of the over?
Drifting down leg, Mohammad lets it be.
Slider around middle, eased down to long on. Vishaul Singh and Alzarri Joseph weren't interested in going after the ball and Chase isn't happy. An easy single taken in the end.
Gets across and brooms it behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Tossed up around off, Ahmed nicely comes forward to keep it out.
Turning down leg, Ahmed leaves it alone.
Good length, angling in from outside off, Abbas looks to poke inside the line and is beaten all ends up. A successful over from Holder.
Angles in a length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Serves it on a back of a length outside off, pretty harmless, Abbas leaves it alone.
Mohammad Abbas is the new man in to face the hat-trick ball!

OUT! Two in two for Jason Holder! And what a delivery, absolute beauty! West Indies are back in this game now. Back of a length delivery just around off, Yasir Shah hangs his bat out to this one. Gets squared up a touch and gets a healthy edge that flies to Kieran Powell at first slip. He fumbles in the first attempt but then collects it in the second one.
Yasir Shah will take the bat next.

OUT! HOLDER HAS HIS MAN! Mohammad Amir is out of here. The West Indies skipper comes from around the wicket and angles it in on middle and leg, Amir looks to put bat on ball but gets an inside edge back onto the stumps. He's bowled and that's the end of his short stay.
Short ball around off, ducked and evaded.
Tossed up on off, Amir clears his front leg and lofts it over mid on. Clears the infield with ease and picks up three runs for it.
Worked away on the leg side for no run.
Spinning away from around off, on a length, slapped straight to the cover fielder.
Attacking the stumps, it is blocked.

Not out! Not a bad review though. Roston flights it on middle and off, it's coming in with the arm and it raps Amir on the front pad. There's a loud appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. West Indies think they've got their man and they go for the review. Replays show that the ball hit the pad first but was going above the stumps. Tough luck for Roston Chase.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Mohammad Amir looks to flick but the ball raps his low on the pads.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Ahmed makes room and plays the ramp shot over the slip cordon for a boundary to end the over.
Fuller on off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller and outside off, driven a bit uppishly through covers. Comes back for the third.
Fuller in length around off, driven towards covers.
Fuller and angling in on middle, Amir gets rapped on the pads. No real appeal as it was going down leg.
Back of a length outside off, but there is no room for Amir to cut. He mistimes it towards point.
Jason Holder to bowl from the other end. Two slips and a gully in place.
Short and outside off, cut away square on the off side for a single.
Kicks off the deck this time, on a shorter length, Amir goes back and dabs it past the second slip fielder.
Beaten! Good delivery. Chase tosses it up around off, Amir looks to defend but is beaten past the outside edge this time.
Comes from around the wicket and floats it around off, Amir leans ahead and defends.

We are back for the final session of the day. Sarfraz Ahmed will continue with Mohammad Amir joining him in the middle. Still plenty of work to be done for Pakistan. Roston Chase to finish his pending over. There are two slips and a silly point in place.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

The visitors picked up the pace a bit in this session. In 27.2 overs, Pakistan have scored 84 runs and lost 3 wickets. The centurion Azhar Ali fell, much like Asad Shafiq, in the quest for quick runs. Misbah-ul-Haq completed his fifty after a patient stay but then departed almost immediately to a loose shot. Roston Chase picked up his 4th wicket of the game and has been West Indies' best bowler. The hosts will try to clean Pakistan up quickly while the latter will look to up the ante. Join us for the final session of the day in just a little bit.

OUT! Misbah departs just at the stroke of tea! What a sad way to get out. But clever bowling from Roston Chase! The Pakistan skipper tried playing a similar shot in Roston's previous over but this time he has to go. Misbah gets into position early to play the reverse sweep and seeing this, Chase fires it outside leg. The veteran still goes through with the shot and ends up getting a top edge and Dowrich behind the stumps takes it this time. Wasn't an easy take but Shane's done well after having a tough time with the mitts. TEA ON DAY 2!
SIX! That's huge! Floated delivery around middle, Misbah gets down on his rear knee and slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen. Clean hit!
Sits back and cuts it past point for a single.
Loopy outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
39th Test fifty for Misbah-ul-Haq!

FOUR! Fifty up for Misbah! He's retiring but he wants to bid adieu in a grand fashion. Tossed up ball around off, Misbah lofts it over mid off and picks up a boundary. Now then, can he manage to convert this into a big one?
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Tossed up around middle, Ahmed drives it towards mid on.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Ahmed looks to flick but gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
Fuller around off, Misbah defends it into the ground.
Misbah looks to reverse sweep it but Chase fires it even more down the leg side, Misbah doesn't play at it.
Sliding in on leg, Sarfraz flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
Gets across and looks to sweep it hard. Makes good connection but it hits the man at short fine leg.
Once again exposes the stumps, it's tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.

What was that! Even before the bowler delivered, Sarfraz goes leg side and exposes his stumps. Chase follows him and fires it around leg, Ahmed looks to sweep but fails to get any wood on it. Gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up on off, some spin away, Misbah keeps bat and pad close together to keep it out.
Plants his front foot forward and pushes it to the covers.
A lot of revs on this, defended off the front foot on the off side.
On the shorter side once more, Misbah pulls again through mid-wicket. Closer to the fielder this time so only two runs taken.
FOUR! Picks his spot, it's in the gap and away to the fence. Misbah goes back to this short ball and whips it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, some width on offer as Ahmed cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Devendra Bishoo is brought into the attack.
Short ball spinning in, rises a bit quickly on Misbah-ul-Haq who somehow uncomfortably manages to pull it away on the leg side.
Flighted delivery around the off stump, gets down and brings out the reverse sweep. Find the fielder at point.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Spinning in to Misbah-ul-Haq, he camps back and tucks it behind square on the leg side. One run taken.
Drops it just back of a driving length, Sarfraz kneels across and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Nice loopy delivery on middle and off, Sarfraz presses forward in defense.
On a length, just around off, pushed from the crease to covers for nothing.
Picks it off his pads and clips it down towards fine leg. One more run taken.
Another short one into the body, pulled away down to fine leg for one more.
Just back of a length, worked away to mid-wicket for one more.
Short of a length delivery angling in, tucked off the back foot behind square on the leg side for a single.
Short ball from Gabriel, it's sharp and accurate which the batsman barely has time to evade. Manages to do so in the end, but just barely.
Outside off on a length, gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards sweeper cover. Three runs are taken.

FOUR! Short and into the body, Misbah goes back to pull. Gets it through backward square leg where Vishaul Singh is in the deep. He runs to his right and makes a good diving stop. The umpire just wants to make sure if he hasn't touched the rope while diving. Replays show he has. It will be a boundary.
It spins in but it's well outside off, no trouble for Misbah to leave it alone.
That was close! Sarfraz survives a mild scare. Loopy and fullish on middle, he comes forward and works it with the spin past FSL. Was in the air and just went past the fielder there. Single taken.
Goes back, works it off his pads to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Turning in on middle and off, Misbah drives it to mid on.
Good length delivery just outside off, kept out off the front foot.
The batsman has hooked that one towards fine leg. They pick up a single.
Back of a length delivery very close to off, cramped for a bit of room as Misbah misses his pull.
Short and going down leg, Misbah calmly sits under it.
Fuller in length outside off, Misbah looks to hit it through the line but gets a bottom edge on it.
Good length delivery on off, defended off the back foot.
Sarfraz lunges forward and defends it into the ground.
Sarfraz Ahmed is the new man in!

OUT! In the air... gone! Credit to Jason Holder for keeping the fielder out in the deep. Shafiq departs in the quest of upping the ante. Tossed up outside off, Asad Shafiq gets down on one knee to slog sweep it. He connects but it goes straight down the throat of Vishaul Singh at deep mid-wicket. Roston Chase picks up his third wicket.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full around off, defended off the front foot.
Safe! Misbah gets across and looks to sweep it. It goes off the top edge and just about evades the man at backward square leg. A couple taken.
Turning in from a length, Shafiq tucks it towards short fine leg for a single.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. They pick up a single.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Shafiq with a solid front foo defense.
Back of a length ball outside off, Asad shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller in length and on the sumps, Shafiq drives it straight back past the bowler. Holder from mid on cuts it off.
Length ball outside off, dabbed with an open face behind point for one.
Gabriel serves a full toss on off, Misbah hits it straight to mid off.
Shannon Gabriel is back.
Comes forward and drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! Aggression from Shafiq! Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Shafiq gets down and hits it with the turn over deep square leg for another boundary in the over.
Full and turning down leg, Shafiq lets it be.
Gets down and across and sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
Shafiq gets down and brooms it through square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Good use of the feet there! Tossed up ball around middle, Shafiq skips down the track and chips it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Did that carry? Misbah chips it a bit uppishly towards mid on where Gabriel dives forward to take it but the ball falls just short of him.
Gets forward and mistimes it towards mid off.
Good length outside off, punched towards covers.
Shortish and angling in on middle, Misbah swivels and pulls it in front of square on the leg side. The two fielders in the deep does well to keep them down to two.
Outside off, played towards point.
Short and outside off, Misbah has no harm in letting it be.
Asad defends it from within the crease.
The ball grips off the surface and turns in sharply with the bounce. It hits Shafiq high on the bat before dying down.
Darts it around middle, worked towards mid on.

Just over a leaping fielder! Full around off, Misbah gets down to sweep, tries to take it on the full but the ball goes off the toe end of the bat and just goes over a leaping Kieran Powell at short mid-wicket for a single.
Goes back and tucks it with the spin through mid-wicket.
Floats it up outside off, it turns in as Misbah off his back foot keeps it out.
Full delivery angling back in, Shafiq crouches a bit to get bat on ball. Manages an inside edge onto his pads and fortunately for him, not back onto the stumps.
Good carry, moving away from a back of a length outside off, the batsman has nothing to do with that.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Joseph brings out the short one and hits the deck hard, it's on middle and off as the batsman ducks under it.
Some inward movement on middle and leg, makes the batsman awkwardly defend it down on the ground in front of mid-wicket.
Good length delivery seaming in, around off, doesn't bounce much which allows Shafiq to come forward and block.
Drinks!

Oh, dear me.... Why isn't there a more attacking field in place? Second time this is happening, yesterday it happened with Azhar Ali and today, with the captain. Turning in and bouncing a bit too, the ball takes a faint inside edge and lobs off the thigh pad. No short leg in place so the ball falls safely.
Looped up on the stumps, driven to the mid on region.
Worked away on the leg side but this time by Misbah-ul-Haq.
A bit uppish from Shafiq as he brings his wrists into play again, chips it but it's safely in the gap between mid on and mid-wicket. Single taken.
Tossed up on off, comfortably worked on the on side.
Tossed up off spinner on off, a bit too full which enables Shafiq to come forward and wrist it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Length delivery from Joseph, pushed to the cover region.
Rising off the deck a bit, on the hips, worked away in front of square on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery, sharply shaping back in on off, Misbah covers the line beautifully and punches it back down the track towards mid on.
On a length this time, bit straight in line as Asad Shafiq tucks it down in front of the mid-wicket area for a comfortable single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, blocked.
Big shout for a leg before, rightly turned down. Was always going down leg. Full and tailing back in, catches Shafiq low on the pads as he looks to flick it across the line.
Alzarri Joseph is brought back into the attack!
Hangs deep inside his crease and ensures the turning ball does not do any damage.
Spinning in, cramps Misbah for room who looks to force it through square on the off side. He still manages to get the cut shot away.
Misbah-ul-Haq has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quite full on middle and leg, swept behind to leg slip, who dives and keeps it from going past him.
On off, some decent flight on this occasion, The Pakistan skipper turns it with the wrists past the vacant FSL position.
Off spinner pitched on a length around off, turns in as Misbah gets back to work it on the leg side.
Harmless length delivery, not much pace on it or movement for that matter, Asad comes forward and blocks it in front of covers.
Just back of a length, on the off pole, defended down into the track from within the crease.
Wide! Short and wide outside off, ducked and evaded. Wide called as it was too short.
Back of a length just around off, left alone. There's some good carry as the keeper collects it at a good height.
Spears it full once again, Shafiq drills it out to mid off. No run this time either.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, driven down to mid on by Asad Shafiq for nothing.
On a slightly fuller length, defended in front of mid-wicket.
FOUR! Picking the pace up a bit here now, is Misbah. Rocks back to this shorter delivery and thumps the pull through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Another one down the leg side, left alone by the batsman.
Spinning down the leg side, a lot of bounce on that occasion too, Misbah looks to sweep but misses.
Stays deep inside the cease to this and blocks.
Heavy spin for Roston Chase as it comes in on middle, Shafiq goes back and tucks it square on the leg side for a single.
Extremely loopy and full well outside off, Asad Shafiq leans across and drives it through the covers. It's in the gap so he'll get a couple of runs for it.
FOUR! Finally Misbah connects one. A short ball outside off, Misbah fetches it from outside off and hits it over the square leg fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, it's defended down gently.
Short of a length ball outside off, Misbah stays back to defend it with a straight blade on the off side.
Short of a length delivery on middle, the batsman ducks under it.
Yorker right on the money, Misbah digs it out on the leg side.
Full and honing in on off, Misbah jams it out to the mid-wicket region.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Covers the line and keeps it out.
Flighted delivery around off, defended off the front foot.
Asad Shafiq will be the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Roston Chase breaks the frustrating stand! Something to cheer for the scanty crowd! Tossed up outside off, Azhar Ali after being too patient decides to take Chase on. Sinks down on one knee to slog sweep but the ball grips, turns and goes right under the bat to knock the stumps. Azhar Ali departs after a classical Test innings.
Darts it on the pads, nudged towards the leg side.
Fuller around off, turned off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Misbah defends it from within the crease.
Shortish on middle, Ali looks to pull but isn't quite in control of this one. Gets it towards square leg for a single.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, Misbah gets it off the inner half towards fine leg for a single. Seems it's gone off the pads, so the umpire signals a leg bye.
No ball! Back of a length outside off, Misbah defends it off the back foot. Holder oversteps and that will be called as a no ball.
Back of a length outside off, a bit of extra bounce and Misbah drops his wrists to let it be.
Fuller and in spearing in on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, punched straight to mid off.
Floated off spinner outside off, turning in, Misbah gets forward to defense and keeps it out from the inside half of the bat. It brushes his pads and dies down towards the vacant short leg region.
Knocks a full ball down to mid on.
Flatter and outside off, not spinning much, Azhar goes back and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Tickles it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Catch it is the shout, but nothing doing. A flighted delivery outside off, Azhar is early into his attempted sweep shot and fails to connect. It goes off his shoulders behind to the fielder at slip.
Extra flight, it's full and on off, Azhar takes a step down the track and then plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Action replay of the previous delivery. Misbah has a truck-load of patience and can leave those all day. A maiden!
Tries to lure the batsman into a drive by bowling it full outside off, Misbah has played enough cricket to sense that. He watchfully takes a stride forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Back of a length ball on off, Misbah gets back inside the crease and taps it down to covers.
Play and a miss! Holder once again bends his back and generates extra bounce outside off, Misbah once again attempts to hook but fails to connect this time.
Bouncer outside off, Misbah tries to hook across the line, fails to middle and plays it along the ground to mid-wicket.
Full in length and around off, Misbah gets across the stumps and defends it towards point.
Quicker delivery, full and going down the leg side, Misbah makes space to slog it across the line but fails to connect. A good take by the keeper.
Leans forward to a full ball and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it to mid on.
Allows the ball to spin back into him and nurdles it through square leg for one.

Nearly a stumping! An early charge from the batsman, seeing which Chase fires it down the leg side, Misbah does well to get something behind it and deflects it past leg gully for a couple. Thought it came off the pads but the umpire gave it as runs, so maybe there was some inside edge.
Tossed up ball around off, swept through backward square leg for a single.
Roston Chase having a word with his skipper Jason Holder. There is a slight change in the field. A deep square leg comes into place along with a leg gully.
Serves an outswinger but the line is too wide outside off to bother the batsman. An easy leave for the Pakistani skipper to end the over.
Angling down the leg side, Misbah picks it off his pads and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fullish and around off, Misbah gets across the stumps with a straight bat and pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Extra bounce from a length around off, Misbah gets back and turns it on the leg side. Although not in control. It goes uppishly through the vacant short leg region to mid-wicket.
Bowls it on a driving length outside off, trying to tempt the batsman, Misbah covers the line and shoulders arms.
Loopy and on middle, swept firmly but the backward square leg fielder did a great job in stopping the ball with a dive. Good intensity shown in the field.
Tossed up and around off, played with the spin wide of mid on but no run.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it towards mid on.
Flighted and on middle, spinning down, Ali allows it through to the keeper.
Bowls an off spinner, landing around off and it's on the shorter side, Ali plays a mistimed pull shot to mid-wicket.
Interesting shot selection! Flighted full ball around off, Misbah plays a reverse sweep past first slip and the ball stops just before the fence at third man. They take three runs.
Roston Chase to continue from the other end.
Pitches it full and on off, a hint of inward shape, Misbah lunges to defend but it catches the inside edge and rolls behind square leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Misbah stays back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad.
Full and swinging ball around off, Ali tries to flick through mid-wicket but it takes the inner half of the bat and runs through backward square leg for one.
Good smart bowling, this. Holder delivers it on a length outside off, it holds its line and Azhar allows it through.
An inswinger on this occasion, landing on a length outside off and jagging back in to hurry the batsman. Ali tries to defend but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Play and a miss first ball! Holder serves it on a length and in the channel outside off, nipping away a bit, Ali pushes inside the line from the crease and misses.

We are back for the afternoon session. Can Pakistan up the ante in this session? Remains to be seen. Out come the players and the umpires. Misbah and Ali to continue from where they left off. West Indies skipper, Jason Holder to start off the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 2...

An absorbing session from Pakistan to say the least. The duo of Misbah-ul-Haq and Azhar Ali have scored just 58 runs in 30 overs. Younis Khan was the only wicket to be lost as the West Indian skipper caught him leg before. There wasn't much on offer for the bowlers, except for when the new ball was doing a bit. Expect a similar afternoon session. Showers are predicted through it, hopefully it doesn't affect the game. Join us in a while for the action...
Pushed quicker through the air around middle, eased down to long on for a single. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Fires it full on the stumps, Misbah jams it out.
Gets forward and works it towards short leg.
Flatter one around middle, Misbah goes back and defends it down.
Fuller on middle, flicked through wide of mid on for a single.
Darts it around middle, flicked past the man at short leg for a single.
Roston Chase comes in for a bowl! A slip and a short leg in place.
Punched stylishly of the back foot by Ali through cover point for a double.
Short ball on the body and he works it to the leg side.
Back of a length ball and Ali defends it off the back foot.
Outside off. The batsman leaves it alone.
Good length ball, Ali tucks it to mid-wicket.
Overpitched and driven to mid on by the batsman.
Jason Holder is back into the attack!
Harmless length ball outside off, the Pakistan skipper will never go after it.
Fullish length delivery on middle, wristed past the man at mid on. Heavy outfield ensures that the ball doesn't cross the rope. But good running allows them to come back for the third.
Shortish and angling in, tucked through mid-wicket for one.
In the channel outside off, it's left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! New bat is working for Misbah, eh? A juicy full toss, angling in, Misbah offers a straight bat drive down the ground. Beats mid on and picks up his first boundary.
Good length this time and Ali flicks it with a wristy shot for no run.
No ball! Again he oversteps. Bowls it short and Azhar plays it of the back foot.
No ball! He's overstepped again. It's his 100 No ball of his career. Bowls it short and the batsman ducks under it.
Short ball again and Ali flicks it off his pad off the back foot.
Again a bouncer down leg. Ali goes for the pull and misses it.
Bowling round the wicket now. Bowls it short down the leg side. Ali lets it go.
Short ball, on the body. Batsman walks across and nudges it for 2 runs behind square.
Back of a length delivery and defends it off the back foot.
Change of bat for Misbah-ul-Haq!
Fuller outside off, driven nicely but finds the cover fielder.
Fuller in length on middle, pushed towards mid on. Misbah has now faced fifty deliveries and scored just a run.
An in-dipping yorker on middle, Ali goes hard at it but gets it off the inner half down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller on off, Ali looks to drive it through the off side but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Shortish in the channel outside off, Ali taps it in front of covers. Wants the single but won't get it.
Back of a length delivery on off, Azhar Ali stays on the back foot to keep it out towards covers.
A bouncer there. Short on the body, Misbah ducks under it.
Back of a length delivery. Misbah covers the line and defends it off the back foot.
Full ball on off stump. Misbah drives it to mid off.
A good length delivery, Misbah defends it off the back foot
Bit fullish in length, outside off, Misbah walks a step across and drives it to the mid off fielder.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven to the covers.
Good length delivery on middle, driven towards mid on.
Fuller ball on the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a couple.

Bye! A wayward delivery miles down the leg side. Misbah stays inside the line and poor Dowrich dives full length to his left but fails to gather the cherry. It goes off his gloves to fine leg. A bye taken.
Good length, angling in, punched on the bounce to the cover fielder.
Fuller in length outside off, Misbah takes a long stride forward and defends it towards the point fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, Misbah shoulders his arms.

That came back in. A brave leave you have to say. Length delivery angling back in from around off, sharp movement off the deck as Azhar Ali leaves it alone. Just about kissed the off pole as it goes behind to the keeper. Close call.
Back of a length and Ali defends it off the back foot.
No ball! He's overstepped by a big margin there. Huge no ball, and the batsman lets the ball go.
Good length, outside off and it's left alone by the batsman.
Full ball, pushed to the cover region.
Full ball, Ali pushes it to mid on.
Length ball on the off stump, Ali forward defenses it.
Drinks have been taken!
Defended of the front foot, showing the full face of the bat.
Outside off again, Misbah leaves the ball.
Yorker, Misbah gets his bat down and digs it out.
Shape away for the bowler, pitched on a good length outside off and the batsman leaves the ball.
Outside off and the batsman left it alone.
A little shape away there for the bowler. Bowls it outside off and the batsman leaves the ball.
Alzarri Joseph returns.
Good carry for Shannon Gabriel, at 138 clicks, it's on a back of a length outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.

FOUR! Shot. Beautiful from Azhar Ali. Such sweet timing right off the meat of the bat. It's full and on off, angling in, Ali leans across a bit and with the full face of the bat, drives it back down past mid on and away to the fence.
Bit too straight as it's angling in on middle and leg, worked away to mid-wicket.
It's full and wide outside off, some attacking intent from Azhar Ali as he walks across to this one. Drives it firmly but it's straight to the man at mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
Angling down the leg side, Ali looks to tickle it fine down the leg side but fails to make any connection. Dowrich behind the stumps runs to his left and and stops the ball from going past him.
The second new ball is available and has been taken by West Indies. Well, it was available 9 overs ago actually, but the hosts have decided to take it now.
Lunges forward and buries it into the ground.
Flatter and shorter outside off, AA sits back and slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single. Brings up the 200 for Pakistan!
Loopy leg break outside off, it spins away, Azhar covers his sticks and lets it be.
Fuller around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Floated full ball around middle, Ali gets down to sweep. Hit it in the deep mid-wicket region and settles for two.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards mid off.
Marginally ahead of a length, just around off, leans a touch ahead and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Length delivery around off, kept out from within the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, it's left alone.
Well outside off, Azhar Ali reaches out to it and drives it a bit square on the off side. Gets it in the gap and three runs are taken as the fielder chases it down. Good timing on that occasion.
Good length delivery, nipping back in off the seam, Ali lifts hit bat to allow it to go through to Dowrich.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the bowling attack.
Pitches it outside off, it turns away, Misbah covers the stumps and lets it go through to the keeper.
Too full and given a bit more flight on middle, bunted back to the bowler.
Gets behind the line and defends it again.
Fuller around off, defended off the front foot.
Very full on the stumps, Misbah crouches low to keep it out.

Hits the timber but at the other end! Tossed up delivery around middle, Misbah clears his front leg and drills it back down the ground. Much to his dismay the ball hits the stumps at the other end. The umpire is lucky to not get hit.
Good length ball on off, punched towards mid off.
Fuller on off, pushed towards the off side.
14th Test hundred for Azhar Ali!

There it is! Another century for Azhar Ali! He takes his helmet off, goes down on his knees and does the Sajdah! Never easy to score big on a slow deck. Coming to the ball, fuller on the pads, clipped fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Risky single! Length delivery outside off, Misbah taps it towards the point fielder and sets off. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses it. Misbah is off the mark.
Good length delivery outside off, Misbah leaves it alone.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Floats it outside off, Ali drives it to the covers.
Another tossed up delivery, Azhar drives it towards covers for nothing.
Fuller on off, Ali once again drives it towards the cover region.
Floated ball outside off, driven towards extra cover where the fielder dives to his right to stop the ball.
Beaten! Tosses it up outside off, lures Ali into the drive. The batsman obliges and the ball turns away past the outside edge.
Leg break outside off, turns away, Ali doesn't bother going after it.
Good length ball, and again defended on the the front foot by Misbah.
Good length ball on the off stump, defends it on the front foot.
Once again, outside off. Misbah leaves the ball.
Good length ball outside off , lets it go to the keeper.
Outside off, pushed through the off side for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Very full around middle and off, driven back towards Bishoo.
Flatter one around off, pushed towards point.
Fuller around off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Floats it up outside off, Misbah offers no stroke.
A leg break around middle, turning away, Misbah goes deep in his crease to defend it.
Tossed up around middle, bunted back to the bowler.
Strays on the pads, clipped through square leg for a couple of runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bye! Strays down the leg side, Ali misses his flick and Dowrich behind the stumps fails to collect it cleanly. The ball goes off his gloves and they take a bye.
Fuller and on the stumps, Ali drives it wide of mid on. Gabriel dives all over the ball and it goes through. The ball goes in the deep and they take three.
Ali lunges forward and pushes it towards the cover region.
In the channel outside off, Azhar shoulders his arms.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman, presenting the full face of the bat.
Spin there for Bishoo, gets the edge and falls just short of slip.
Flighted ball, edged through slip for a single.
Dances down the track and drives it down the ground to mid off.
Full on middle stump. Ali gets down and sweeps it for a single.
Full ball, driven down the ground.
Drinks break!

Edged and dropped! Dear! Oh dear! What have you done Dowrich? Misbah-ul-Haq survives a scare here! Holder serves it fuller in the corridor outside off, it shapes away a bit after pitching as Misbah lunges forward to poke at it. An outside edge is induced behind. Shane Dowrich initially was moving to his left but then at the last moment had to dive to his right. The ball doesn't stick in his mitts and dies down. Holder can't believe his luck. How costly will this prove to be?
Sprays it a bit down the leg side, Ali moves inside the line and clips it down to fine leg for one.
Continues to bowl it in the corridor outside off, Azhar pushes it off the front foot towards covers.
Fuller and nipping back in a shade, Azhar prods forward to block it out.
Fuller and wide outside off, Ali doesn't play at it.
Angles in a low full toss on the pads, glanced down to long leg for a brace.
Slower through the air. Misbah crouches and defends it.
Slightly short, pushes the ball off the back foot
Full flighted ball, pushes it to cover.
Flighted delivery, full length and defends it back.
Short ball, slow turn for Bishoo. Ali rocks back and cuts it for a run.
Really full ball by Bishoo. Ali drives it to covers.
Length ball on off, pushed towards covers.

Misbah-ul-Haq strides out to the center. Like Younis Khan, he too is greeted with a Guard Of Honour from the West Indian team. Shakes hand with Jason Holder, appreciates the respect shown to him from the rest of the team and takes his place at the striker's end.

OUT! The decision stands! Younis Khan is out of here! Holder comes running in and angles in a length delivery on middle and leg. Younis walks across the sticks to work it away on the leg side but is undone by the inward movement there and is hit on the pads. Jason appeals long and hard and umpire Oxenford after taking his time raises his dreaded finger. It seemed to be going down leg and after consulting with Azhar Ali, Khan opts for the review. Replays show the impact is in line and would have gone on to clip the leg stump. The on-field decision stays put and that is it for Younis.
Younis Khan is adjudged LBW but the veteran refers it straightaway. The question is, is it going down leg? Let's wait and find out...
Fuller and sprayed wide outside off, Khan leans forward and drives it towards the cover-point fielder.
Once again Holder pitches it right up there, Khan drives it towards mid off but fails to get any timing behind it.
Overpitches it this time, on off, Younis gets forward and drives it towards mid off.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Khan lifts his bat and lets it be.
Some sharp turn away from Azhar Ali, he tries to put bat on ball but fails.
Tossed up on middle and off, Khan sweeps it 'round the corner and takes a single.
Excellent delivery from Bishoo, absolute peach. Some drift in, it's floated on off, turns away and beats the outside edge of Younis Khan's bat.
Spinning away, outside off, dabbed to short third man with an open face.
Gives the charge to this one and goes after Bishoo. Gets to the pitch and lofts it over mid off. Doesn't time it well but it's enough to clear the infield and take two runs.
Full delivery, very full in fact, on off, Younis buries it into the track.
Devendra Bishoo is brought into the attack. A slip in place for him.
Again outside off by Holder. Ali lets the ball go again
Outside off stump on a good length, left alone.
On a good length. defends it straight back to the bowler.
Full ball, outside off driven between point and covers and picks up a single. First run after 5 overs there
A little away swing for Holder, But was outside off. Younis shoulders arms to it.
Good length, outside off left alone by Younis.
Jason Holder is into the attack now.
Fifth maiden in a row. This is good pressure from the West Indian bowlers. Alzarri Joseph pitches it in the channel outside off, Azhar Ali lets it be.
Bangs it on a shorter side, around off, Azhar Ali gets on top of the bounce and defends it down on the track.
Short of a length around off, kept out off the back foot.
Full again, outside off, Ali drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Outside off on a good length, Azhar makes a decent leave.
Full and angling in, skidding off the surface a bit too, Azhar positions himself right behind the line to meet it with the full face of the bat.
Slower ball, Thats the third slower ball in the over. Younis defends it to cover presenting the full face of the bat.
Full ball on middle, Younis punches it to mid on.
Slower ball again by Gabriel, Younis drives it to mid on. Watchful there by Younis.
A silly mid off is in place now...
Full again, outside off this time, Younis covers the line and drives it to mid off.
Tailing back in, full on middle. Younis gets an inside edge to mid-wicket.
Slower ball, full on off stump, Younis drives it to mid on.
Another back of a length delivery, outside off, punched off the back foot in front of covers.
On the shorter side of the length, very close to the off pole, kept out with the full face of the bat.
Fullish in length, it's driven back down the track. Won't get any run for it though.
Excellent carry for Joseph. Comes steaming in and serves it on a good length in the off stump channel, Azhar Ali covers the line and lets it through.
That came back in a long way. Joseph pitches this on a length outside off, hits the deck and it tails in to hit him on the pads. No shout though as height was an issue.
Fires it full and outside off, shaping away a touch, Azhar looks to drive but gets it off the inner half on the leg side.
Hits the good length again Younis covers the line of the ball and defends the ball. Good over by Gabriel.
Outside off on a good length, Younis lets the ball go. Good line there by Gabriel.
Good length delivery on the off stump, Younis defends it back to the bowler.
Full ball, Younis drives it straight to mid on.
Back of a length into the body. Nudges it to mid wicket.
Gabriel bowls on a good length, Younis Khan defends it on the front foot.
Hurls it full and well outside off, Ali leans ahead and pushes it to the cover-point fielder.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full and angling in, with a closed face it's flicked to the mid-wicket area.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azhar stays back and punches it to covers.
Coming back in on middle and leg, Ali works it to mid-wicket.
Starts off with a fuller length delivery in the off stump channel, Azhar Ali shoulders his arms to it.
Alzarri Joseph will bowl from the other end.
Good length delivery aiming the top of off stump, with the full face of the bat pushes it back to the left of the bowler.

FOUR! In complete control of that shot. First boundary of the second day. Short and wide outside off, Younis latches on the width and cuts it sweetly through cover-point. It's hit too well and the ball goes all the way to the boundary line.
Short ball on middle and off, Khan ducks and evades.
Darts it on a back of a length, outside the line of off stump, stands tall and defends it on the off side.
Back of a length delivery coming into the body, Younis hops and taps it down on the track beside him.
Angles in a length delivery from around off, Younis Khan jumps across, gets behind the line and keeps it out on the off side.

The sun is shining over at Windsor Park and we are all set to get underway. Azhar Ali strides out to the middle with Younis Khan, who's playing his last ever Test match. The West Indies team take their positions out in the field. Shannon Gabriel will take the ball first up. He has two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

West Indies couldn't take full advantage of winning the toss. The opted to bowl under the overcast conditions but couldn't make the kind of impact they would have liked to with the ball. The wicket has gotten easier to bat on now, but it'll spin and grip. Roston Chase proved to the best of the lot and he'll be the main threat for the visitors. There is rain forecast for today as well, so we hope it stays away.

Good news to start off with. We have blue skies in Dominica and we'll start on the scheduled early time, that is 0930 local. Yesterday, the rain came to ruin the entire second and then bad light took away the end of the final session. Pakistan have lost two wickets and now, Azhar Ali and Younis Khan are currently batting out in the middle, rather solidly too.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ...

It was Alzarri Jospeh who broke the 120-run stand by sending Babar Azam back. Since then the veteran, Younis Khan walked in and has kept the hosts at bay. Azhar Ali at the other end seems to have gotten his eye in and looks like he is on the road to score big. There is turn and bounce on offer on the pitch and it would be interesting to see if the visitors can continue the good work tomorrow. The hosts would look to come out afresh and sneak a couple of quick wickets to limit the damage. We will have an early start tomorrow at 0930 local for the time and overs lost today. The radar for the next few days doesn't look good and let's hope for the best. Do join us for all the action from day 2, weather permitting. Until then, goodbye. Cheers!

Pakistan's day! On what was an overcast morning, they lost Shan Masood early and it seemed like the West Indies pacers will take full toll of the overhead conditions. But the pair of Azhar Ali and Babar Azam denied them. The duo joined forces and negotiated quite well. Though they weren't allowed to score that freely as the lines and lengths bowled by the hosts were pretty disciplined. The second session was completely washed out and when the players walked out for the extended final session, both the batsmen got to their respective fifties.

It has gotten pretty dark out there and the umpires have called for the light meter. Umpire Bruce Oxenford takes the reading and it shows 103, doesn't please him. Which means it has to remain same for the next four days. The umpires are asking the players to trudge back to their respective dressing rooms. STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Straighter one around off, Ali leaves it alone.
Comes forward and pushes it towards the on side.
Fuller around off, bunted towards mid on.
Darts it around the pads, worked towards the leg side.
Tossed up on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Younis brings out the sweep and gets it towards fine leg for a single.
Walks across and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length delivery on middle, tucked towards fine leg for one.
Fuller on the stumps, Ali drives it towards the mid on fielder.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, Ali misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards Dowrich.
Azhar gets forward and pushes it to mid on.
Shortish on off, defended off the back foot.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Brings the wrists into play and works it to mid-wicket.
On the shorter side, defended off the back foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full toss on the stumps, swept away towards fine leg for one.
Turning in from around off, some good bounce on that occasion, Ali goes back and works it past FSL for a single.

Loud shout for an lbw! But it's turned down. Angling in on middle and off, keeps a bit low and it takes Younis Khan by surprise. Raps him on the pads and there's a loud shout. The umpire stays unmoved, rightly so too. There was an inside edge before the ball hit the pads. Good decision.
Bit straight in line, flicked away to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery outside off, Khan shoulders his arms to it.
Bangs it on a shortish length, on off, hops across to this and works it down in front of mid-wicket.
Just back of a length, very close to the off pole, Younis moves across to get behind the line and blocks.
Back of a length delivery outside off, it keeps a little low as Younis Khan cuts it away to point.
Jason Holder returns.
FOUR! Loopy full ball around off, Azhar Ali kneels down and slog sweeps it aerially with the spin through mid-wicket. It's in the gap and through to the boundary line.
Stays back to this, it grips and bounces off the deck, defended.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Fuller again, outside off, Ali drives it to the covers again.
Gives it plenty of flight, outside off, driven to the covers.
Tossed up off spinner just outside off, Azhar Ali leans across and turns it to wide mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, Khan works it towards mid-wicket.
Wide! Short on middle, it bounces way too much as Khan ducks under it.
Fuller on off, defended off the outer part of the bat towards the off side.

Almost took him by surprise! Gabriel hits the deck hard and gets a bit of bounce on it. Ali comes forward but then had no time to go back. Tries fending it with one hand. The ball goes past Dowrich to fine leg. A single take. What an effort delivery, that.
Sprays down the leg side, Ali tries clipping it but fails to get any wood on it.
AA shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fuller and angling in on middle, Ali flicks it towards mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Goes back and defends it in front of FSL.
Gets down and brooms it through square leg for one.
Younis is living dangerously! The ball turns in with a good amount of bounce as Younis goes back to tuck it away. The ball goes off the gloves and evades the keeper and the man at short leg.
Seems like Holder heard my colleague. He's immediately brought a short leg and a slip in place...
Full around middle, Khan covers the line and works it towards mid-wicket. My colleague just blasted out as to why Holder is not having an attacking field. Where is short leg, Jason?
Sharp turn! Tossed up outside off, turns in sharply as Younis comes forward to defend. The ball goes off the pads and lobs behind to the left of the keeper.
Roston Chase is back into the attack.

Angles it on middle and leg, Ali tries to turn it through the leg side but maybe he closes the face of the bat a tad early. The ball goes off the leading edge but falls ages short of the man at short extra cover.
Shortish delivery, no real pace on it. Younis Khan walks across the sticks and tickles it off his hips past the keeper's left. A single taken.
Fullish length delivery, coming in with the angle, Younis mistimes his drive towards the man at mid off.
Fires in a full length delivery on off, bunted back to Shannon.
Back of a length, angling in, the jumping jack hops in the crease to keep it out.
Blocked off the front foot to cover-point.
Back of a length ball outside off, Azhar Ali doesn't fiddle with those.

FOUR! Nailed it! Joseph darts in a short ball on off, it sits up at a nice height for Ali who swivels a touch and nails the pull through mid-wicket. Has enough legs to send it across the rope. 150 up for Pakistan!
Stays put behind the line and drives it with the straightest of bats to mid on.
Fuller on the pads, helped down to fine leg for an easy single.
Good length delivery on off, punched towards short extra cover.
Fuller on middle, jammed back to the bowler.

Bye! Short and miles down the leg side, Khan tries to put bat on it but it's way far from his reach. It goes on the bounce to Dowrich behind who fails to collect it. The ball goes off his pads towards square leg and the batsmen take a bye.
Fullish on off, Younis comes nicely forward and drives it towards mid off.
Fuller again on middle, Younis drives it past the non-striker towards mid on.
Angles in a full length delivery on middle and off, Khan is right behind it and defends it down gently.
Fuller this time on off, Khan drives it towards the point fielder.
Goes wide of the crease and keeps it on a length on off, Khan mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Landed outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Very full on off, dug out towards mid off.
Touch short on off, Ali off the back foot looks to punch but is a bit cramped for room. Mistimes it towards Hetmyer at cover-point.
Harmless full length ball around off, Azhar won't go after it.
Back of a length ball, angling in on middle, tucked towards square leg off the back foot.
Another very full length delivery, right at the base of the off stump. Younis gets across and jams it back down the track.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it in from around off, YK gets right behind it to defend it down.
Spears in a full length delivery on off, Khan off the front foot drives it towards covers.
Back of a length and tailing back in with the angle, Younis drops his wrists to let it pass.
A bit too straight this time from Gabriel. Younis is quick to get across and help it past the square leg umpire. Bishoo gives it a chase but they take a couple till then.
Fuller and coming in with the angle, Khan almost falls over as he tries to jam it out.
AA has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Misfield! Fuller on off, Younis Khan leans forward and drives it past the diving short cover fielder. Gabriel from mid off comes across to his left and lets the ball go through. What should have been one, it's turned out to be three. The veteran is off the mark!
Presses forward and drives it straight to mid off.
Fuller and served wide outside off, YK reaches out to drive but finds point.
Back of a length ball outside off, Younis Khan stays behind the line to keep it out with a straight willow.
Fuller and wider outside off, Younis Khan leans across and drives it towards cover-point.
Drinks have been taken!
Fuller in length and it shapes away off the seam, Ali covers the stumps and lets it pass.
Fuller in length on off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Bat flying, not the bird! Angles in a length delivery on middle, Ali looks to punch it off the back foot but the bat slips out of his hands and falls just wide of the leg stick. Lucky!
On a length and it jags back in sharply from outside off. Ali covers the sticks and allows it to go through. That whizzes past the off pole.
FOUR! Flayed! Short once again, provides enormous width and Azhar Ali is too good a player to let it be. He sits back and slaps it powerfully through point for a boundary.
Gabriel bangs in a short ball outside off, cramps Ali for room who looks to cut. The Pakistan opener chops it besides the pitch.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the bowling attack.
Pitches it right up there, it's driven straight to short cover. End of a successful over from Khan.
Good length delivery on off, Khan defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery in that probing zone. Younis taps it in front of point, wants the single but is sent back.
Good length in the channel on off, Khan offers no stroke.

Younis Khan walks into the middle next, maybe for the last time. He's greeted with a Guard Of Honour by the West Indian team. Good show of respect from the home side. Younis hugs Jason Holder, shows his gratitude for their gesture and takes his guard at the striker's end.

OUT! Gone! Alzarri Joseph strikes! A much-needed breakthrough for the hosts. Joseph keeps it full in the channel on off, Babar Azam with no foot movement tries to drive but then tries to pull out of the shot at the last moment. He's a bit late as the ball shapes away, takes the outside part of the willow and flies towards first slip where Powell takes a good low catch. Azam walks back dejected and with that, the 120-run stand comes to an end.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Azam covers the sticks and lets it be.
Short and outside off, Ali mistimes the cut shot towards the point fielder.
Full and a bit too straight, clipped towards the on side.
Moves away a touch after pitching, Azhar once again lets it be.
In the channel outside off, Ali leaves it alone.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Azam pulls it in front of square on the leg side. Won't get a boundary but some good running between the wickets allows them to come back for the third.
Drives it to the cover region once more. Another dot ball.
Pitches it a little ahead of a length, it's pushed to the covers. No run taken.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Ali moves across, covers the line and shoulders arms.

Oooh! That was close, wasn't it? Back of a length just outside off, Azhar Ali plays at it and gets an inside edge behind. It bounces in front of the stumps and then goes over it. He tries covering the stumps but the ball evades it easily. However, would have been close had the ball been threatening to hit 'em.
Outside off on a good length, it's not played at by the batsman.
Good length delivery outside off, defended from within his crease.
Some swing for the Windies skipper, going away, Azam plays it down on the track in front of point.
Too straight from Jason Holder, Babar tucks it fine down the leg side for two runs.
Shaping away from around off, it's left alone.
Fuller just around off, Babar Azam walks across his stumps and turns it to mid-wicket. Thinks of taking the run but seeing the fielder charging to the ball, shouts NO to his partner.
Short of a length outside off, Babar Azam shoulders arms after the covering the line.
Bit cramped for room, Ali can only manage a bottom edge to the left of the bowler.

Much better, now this is what West Indies should have been doing much earlier. They're frustrating Pakistan for runs and Azhar Ali has tried to do something different. Backs away a bit and off the toe end, dabs it to gully.
Another dot ball. It's cut away to point, straight to the fielder positioned there.
Banged in on the shorter side, Ali stands tall and works it away square to point.
Bit further away this time, the Pakistan opener wants nothing to do with it.
Very close to the off stump, shaping back in on a short of a length, Ali covers the line well and doesn't offer a shot.
Serves it in the off stump channel, withdraws his bat to let it through.
Makes the batsman play this time, attacks the stumps, it's worked away to mid-wicket.
Holder persists with it, pitches it way outside again, Babar Azam gleefully leaves it alone.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Another one outside off, going away from the batsman, it's left alone.
Well outside off, moving away, no shot offered.
4th Test fifty for Babar Azam!

Fifty for Babar Azam! Short and wide outside off, Azam cuts it through cover-point. There's some hesitation but the batsmen manage to take three runs. Babar brings his fifty up, it's been a solid knock from him so far.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length around off, Azhar Ali goes for the pull shot but gets an inside edge back to the keeper on the bounce.
Jagging back in from around off, Ali moves across and plays it to mid on off the inner half.
Length delivery outside off, way outside off, no problem for the batsman to leave it alone.
Alzarri Joseph is back on.
Comes from wide of the crease and angles it in from around off, Azam gets behind the line and defends.
Good length just around off, pushes away to cover-point. This is a good line from Jason Holder.
Pitches it fractionally ahead of a length, outside off, Azam crouches a bit and pushes it on the off side.
Way outside off, an easy leave for Babar Azam.
Similar line from Jason Holder, it's hit to point for no run.
Hurled on a good length, just outside off, stays back and punches it with a straight bat to the left of the bowler.
Drops this on a length, outside off, punched away to end the over.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortens the length on this, Azam goes back and slaps it through the gap in the covers. It won't go all the way but it's enough to fetch him three runs.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Gripping off the surface, spinning away from around off, Babar Azam has nothing to do with it.
Pushes this quicker through the air, on middle and off, Babar brings his bat down in time to block.
Shortish ball banged in on middle and off, Ali hops across and taps it down on the leg side.
Closes the face and works it to the mid-wicket fielder on this occasion.
Keeps it around the off stump line this time, driven to covers.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, driven to mid on by Azhar Ali. Dot ball.
Tailing back in on leg, Azhar picks it off his pads and flicks it to square leg. Hetmyer there runs to his right and makes a good diving stop. Brilliant effort.
Fullish in length and on the pads, clipped away through the gap in the mid-wicket area for a brace.
Full on the stumps, driven straight back to Devendra Bishoo.
Azhar Ali has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Some slight turn away, not much, but it's enough for Azhar Ali to not have anything to do with it.
Full outside off, Ali drives it through the covers. The fielder chases it down and keeps the batsmen down to two.
Outside off this time, it's pushed to the cover region for nothing.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Azam meets the ball where it pitches and turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
Goes back to this shorter ball and defends it off the back foot.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
100-run stand between Ali and Azam!
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, there's width on offer which Azhar Ali takes. Cuts it over the slip cordon and sends it across the third man boundary.
Bit straight in line again, flicked through backward square leg for a double.
FOUR! Poor line and that's put away. Shane Dowrich had no chance of stopping that. Spills it down leg, Ali just helps it on its way. Beats the diving keeper and sends it across the fine leg fence.
Good length delivery outside off, Azhar goes across, gets behind the line and blocks it down on the off side.
Outside off, landed on a shorter length, cut away to point for a run.
Similar ball, same shot. Same result.
Flighted ball well outside off, leans ahead and drives it to covers.
Keeps tossing it up there, Azam plays a square drive through point and picks up a single.

Hasn't hit this one cleanly but still has enough to clear Jason Holder at mid off. Comes down the track, isn't exactly to the pitch to the ball as he lofts it down the ground. Falls safely and two runs are taken.
Quite loopy and too full, Babar drills it straight to extra cover.
Drinks break!
Hurls in a length delivery, it straightens a touch after pitching, double A counters it with a solid defense.
Slants it full on middle and leg, Ali gets across to defend it.
Now Jason Holder seems to be unfit. He's catching his right shoulder and looks to be in some pain...
Touch fuller on off, Azhar Ali presses forward to keep it out.
Good length delivery on middle and off, defended down gently.
Full and on the middle stump, Azam works it through mid-wicket and scampers through for a quick single.
Shorter outside off, Azam defends it off the back foot towards covers.
Jason Holder comes back into the attack!
Flighted ball around off, driven towards the cover region.
Shorter on off, slapped straight to cover.
Tossed up around middle, jammed out towards extra cover.
26th Test fifty for Azhar Ali!
There it is, fifty for Azhar Ali! Raises his bat towards the dressing room! Flatter outside off, Ali goes back and punches it through covers for a couple.
Shannon Gabriel has left the field for some medical assistance...
Floated around off, pushed once again towards the cover region.
Tossed up outside off, Ali drives it straight to short cover.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on.
Bowls it pretty full, driven to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Azam stays deep inside his crease and punches it towards the point region.
Skidding off the surface a bit, angling in from around off, Babar brings his bat down and off the toe end, defends it behind towards the slip cordon.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Shannon Gabriel looks in some discomfort out there. After the last delivery he seems to have a side strain.
Good length delivery angling down, Babar brings his bat in front of his pads and blocks it down on the track.
Pulls the length back on this again, Azam goes back and cuts it through covers for a single.
Extra bounce for the leggie, it zips off the deck and beats the edge as Azam looks to put bat on ball.
Drops this on a length, cuts it away straight to point.
FOUR! A bish from Bishoo, half-tracker on off, and Babar Azam is onto this in a flash. Rocks back quickly and pulls it along the ground through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Some sharp turn, good bounce, left alone.
Short, turning away and on a shorter length outside off, Azam quickly rocks back and cuts it hard to the cover fielder. Unable to pierce the gap there.
Azhar Ali chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. Quite harmless, into Shane Dowrich's gloves and that'll be the end of the over.
No ball! Short and angling down, the batsman ducks under it. Gabriel oversteps again, so the umpire signals it as a no ball.
Length ball outside off, leans forward a touch and defends it well.
Quite full, almost a half-volley outside off, Azhar Ali leans ahead and drives it right off the meat. Is unfortunate that it's straight to the cover fielder.
Walks across, covers the line well and leaves it. It's outside off, nothing dangerous about it.
Errs in line once more here, Shannon Gabriel. Ali glances it off his hips towards fine leg and takes a couple of runs.
Good running between the wicket. It's angling in on the stumps, Babar taps it in front of mid on and both batsmen set off. Complete the run easily too.
Flatter delivery from Bishoo, it's blocked.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Darted on off, jammed out to covers. Dot ball.
One more short ball, defended off the back foot.
Spinning away from the batsman, on a bit of a shorter length, it's kept out off the back foot.
Full toss to start off with, on middle, Azam comes ahead, uses his wrists and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball which is driven straight to the mid off fielder. That'll be the end of the over.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. Leg byes given by the umpire.
Another bouncer, it's angling down leg a bit, ducked and evaded again.
Stays within his crease and defends it solidly.
Accurate bumper from Shannon, really bends his back while bowling this, the batsman ducks and evades.
Bit ahead of a length, Babar comes forward to drive but it's not full enough to drive. Gets it off the inner half down to mid on.
On a length and outside off, cracked towards covers where a good save from the fielder stops the batsmen from taking any runs.

Bishoo gives it this a lot of revs, it's slower through the air as Babar Azam sweeps it down to fine leg. The single is completed, but Azhar Ali wants the second. The throw coming in is accurate so he's sent back. In good time too, he manages to plant his bat back in in time.
Flighted delivery on off, blocked by taking a lunge forward.
Presses forward to this fuller length ball and meets it with a straight blade.
Stays within his crease and defends it solidly.
Floats it up around off, Babar covers the line and lets it be.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Gabriel goes too straight again, no trouble for the batsman to work it through mid-wicket. Two more runs to the total. Gabriel needs to be more consistent with his lines, he's straying a bit too often today.
Coming back in on middle and leg, Ali works it off his pads and defends it down in front of mid-wicket.
On a good length, Gabriel lands this in the off stump channel, doesn't bother with himself with that.
Good length delivery just outside the off stump line, Azhar plants his front foot forward and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Too straight again, fires it on the pads, Azhar tickles it fine down the leg side. The fielder at fine leg runs to his right and cuts it off. The batsmen take a couple of runs.
Plays this towards cover-point and takes a single.
Has nothing to do with this. It's quite harmless, well outside off so it's left alone.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Spinning away from the opener, on a shorter length, he gets back and cuts it to point.
Azhar Ali offers another back foot punch but finds the gap this time. Pierces the covers and picks up two runs for it.
A decent amount of flight here as Bishoo loops it just back of a driving length, Ali camps back and punches it away on the off side.
Rock solid in defense from the Pakistan No.3. Positions himself perfectly behind the line and blocks it in front of cover-point.
No ball! That's his second of the day. Oversteps once more, by a good margin, on this occasion. It's a length ball outside off, Azam comes ahead to defend.
Speared in full, aiming the base of off stump, Babar drives it straight back to Shannon Gabriel.
Comes from wide of the crease, angles it in on a length from around off, Babar Azam walks a step across, covers the line and meets it with a straight bat.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot straight to the cover fielder.
Quite straight, easy enough for Babar Azam to flick it through mid-wicket for a couple of good runs. The fielder there chases it down and throws it back in.
Superb ball. Great line, in the corridor, holds its shape as Babar Azam tries to feel for it. Is beaten past the outside edge and the ball thuds into Dowrich's gloves.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square to point for nothing.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Shorter in length, pitched around off, kept out off the back foot.
Babar Azam kneels down to this and sweeps it down towards fine leg for a run.
Looped up from the leggie, outside off, left alone for the keeper.

DROPPED! This is a leg spinner's dream, perfect delivery. Absolute peach. Flights it on off, it turns and kicks off the deck as well. Babar Azam prods forward in defense as the ball takes the outside edge. Dowrich moves to his right but can't hold on to it. Should have taken it, was an excellent chance to take. Bishoo is unlucky.
