Hurls it outside off, on a good length again, takes a big stride forward to leave it alone.
Length ball which is angling in once more, it's flicked off the pads behind square on the leg side for two.
Back of a length in the channel outside off, rising off the deck as Azhar Ali raises his bat to let it through.
Angling down, goes off Azhar Ali's pads as he attempts to flick. It runs down to fine leg where the fielder runs to his right and slides to keep it from the rope. Two leg byes taken.
Slightly fullish in length, outside off, driven to mid off with the full face of the bat.
Gabriel comes running in and fires it full, it's angling down the leg side and goes off the batsman's pads as he looks to flick. Dot ball.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl from the other end.
Looped up around the off stump, defended.
Outside off on a length, played to point.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fuller and outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
On the shorter side once more, well outside off, blocked.
Short and wide outside off, spinning away, Babar Azam goes back and cracks it towards the covers where a dive from the fielders saves a certain boundary. Two runs taken in the end.
Time for resumption. The players and umpires are out in the middle. 48 overs left in the day, light and weather permitting. Devendra Bishoo to start first up. Let's play...
...Day 1, Session 3...

UPDATE 1445 LOCAL - The good news is in. The rain has stopped and the covers are being taken off. The word from the middle is that EARLY TEA has been taken. The groundstaff has plenty to do now. If the rain doesn't return, PLAY WILL RESUME AT 1505 LOCAL TIME.

UPDATE 1343 LOCAL - The drizzle seems to have gotten heavier in the last few minutes. We might be in for a longer delay than expected. Pretty dark out there too. Stay tuned, we'll keep you guys updated.

It has started to drizzle again. More lights have come on and the umpire has signalled the players to get off the field. The stumps have been dislodged, the covers are coming back on and we're in for another halt in play. We'll keep you posted with the developments.
On the fuller side of things once more, pushed straight back to the bowler.
Marginally ahead of a length, comes onto his front foot again and drives, to the covers this time.
Full and just outside off, takes a big lunge forward and drives it to mid off. Straight towards the fielder.
No ball! Back of a length delivery around off, Ali punches it off the back foot to covers. No ball called as Gabriel overstepped his line.
Angling in on the pads, flicked past the mid-wicket fielder. He chases it down and keeps the batsmen to just one. Good fielding, stopped the second run with his quick running.
Well bowled! Accurate yorker on off, Babar Azam does well to bring his bat down in time and jam it out back down the track.
Angles in a length delivery on middle and off, Babar Azam from within his crease defends it on the leg side.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl from the other end!
Looped up on the stumps, it's swept down towards fine leg. The batsmen comfortably pick up two runs.
Fires it way outside off, Azhar lets it be.
Drags his length back on this occasion and bowls it around off, gets some turn off the deck as Azhar Ali gets back to block.
A bit straight in line, Babar Azam works it away on the leg side for a single.
Turning away as it pitches on middle and off, Azam stands his ground and meets it with a straight bat.
Tossed up on off, Azam prods forward in defense.

So, good news! The rain has stopped, the covers are off and play will be resuming now. It's highly overcast and don't be surprised if it pours again. Let's hope it now. The floodlights are on as well. It will be Devendra Bishoo to start off with the ball. Babar Azam will be on strike...
We are back for the afternoon session. But we're going to have a delay in the start of the session as the drizzle is back. The covers are on and we're in for a wait here. Stay tuned for updates.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

An even opening session! After winning the toss and opting to bowl, West Indies will be pleased with their effort. Their pacers bowled disciplined lines and lengths to not let the Pakistan batsmen score runs freely. Roston Chase was very impressive in his spell as he got the ball to turn and bounce. After bowling three maidens in a row, he removed Shan Masood but Azhar Ali kept his calm at one end. Babar Azam gave him good support and the duo is going on quite well. The conditions are still overcast and the hosts would look to nip a few when they come back in the next session. Join us in a bit for the afternoon session...
Length delivery wide outside off, Azhar Ali opens the bat face and dabs it towards backward point. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Just back of a length, it's coming back in, Ali stays in his crease and pushes it towards mid on.
Bit ahead of a length and outside off, blocked in front of covers.
Fullish outside off, driven towards the mid off fielder. No run taken.
Fuller and angling in on middle and leg, worked away to mid-wicket. The bat turned in his hands as he played that shot.
Full ball on the stumps, driven towards mid on for nothing.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl once more.
Leg break outside off, Azam doesn't fiddle with it.
Flatter one around off, punched towards covers.
50-run stand between Ali and Azam!
Once again it's Vishaul Singh! Short and outside off, Ali slaps it past Singh at extra cover and once again comes back for the third.
Short and turning away from outside off, Azam goes back and cuts it through extra cover. Vishaul Singh dives but fails to stop it. They take three.
Floats it up around middle, swept through backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, Ali defends it off the front foot.
Devendra Bishoo comes on to roll his arm.
Another bounce by Holder, Azam lets it sail over him to the keeper.
Wide! Holder bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Azam ducks to evade it.
Azam gets across and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on middle, Azam looks to defend it off the front foot but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Holder slips one down the leg side, Ali clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller in length on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Angles in a length delivery outside off, Ali defends it down.
Jason Holder brings himself back on for another spell.
On a length and outside off, Azam punches it towards sweeper cover for a couple.
Harmless delivery outside off, Babar shoulders his arms.
Fuller in length on off, driven towards mid off.
Shortish ball outside off, Azam defends it off the back foot.
Angles it in from outside off, Azam lifts his bat to let it be.
Good length delivery outside off, Azam shoulders his arms to it.
Shuffles across a bit and tucks it towards the leg side.
Too full and straight from Alzarri, Ali drives it back to the bowler who half-stops it and parries it towards mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortish delivery, on middle and leg, Ali tucks it away.
Short and angling in on the body, Ali pulls it in front of square on the leg side and runs two.
On a length and it shapes away a bit, Ali shoulders his arms.
Good length ball, angling in, Azam stays behind the line to keep it out.
Touch short and outside off, Azam taps it towards the point fielder and looks to run. Ali sends him back as the fielder was quick towards the ball.
On a length and outside off, Azam punches it past the covers. The fielder from mid off gives it a chase and keeps them down to a brace.
Good length delivery outside off, BA shoulders his arms.
Babar stays back to this length delivery and defends it down.
Back of a length, angling in, Ali punches it down the ground past the bowler towards mid on. They take a single.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the attack.
FOUR! Crashed! Joseph errs in length, bowls it short. Wide outside off, Azam stays back and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Azam goes on the back foot and punches it towards the cover fielder.
On a good length and outside off, Azam leaves it alone.
Shortish on off, Azam hangs back in defense.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam shoulders his arms to it.
Lunges forward and turns it towards short mid-wicket.
The floodlights have been turned on. It's gotten real dark out there.
Tossed up outside off, Azam makes room and drills it through cover-point. Won't get a boundary but will collect another three.
Floated ball around off, pushed towards mid on.
Turning in from around off, defended towards the leg side.
Very full around off, Azam comes down the track and digs it out back to the bowler who leaps and stops it with his left hand.
Tossed up delivery around off, defended in front of the man at short leg leg.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Babar Azam hops a bit and crunches it a bit square of the wicket on the off side. Bishoo gives it a chase and does well to pull the ball back in play. They see if Bishoo made contact with the rope when he had the cherry in his hands. He didn't. Three runs taken.
Covers the line and defends it down gently.
Drags the length a bit short on off, Babar with no foot movement looks to push it away on the off side. Gets an inside edge which rolls past the stumps.
Fuller and good amount of pace on this one, Azam tries clipping it off his pads but misses and gets a beating on it.
Much better! Hurls it on a length and gets it to angle in from outside off. Babar stays back and defends it down with a straight blade.
FOUR! Nicely done! Fuller and angling in on the pads, easy pickings for Azam as he flicks it through square leg and picks up a boundary. Not an ideal start for Joseph in his second spell.
Alzarri Joseph is back on.
Loopy full toss around off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
A bit flatter around middle, gives time to Azam to tuck it towards square leg for a single.
Full on the stumps, Azam digs it out.
Darts it around middle and leg, flicked behind square on the leg side for one.
SIX! Another biggie for Ali! Gets down on one knee and brooms it neatly with the turn and deposits it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Tossed up outside off, Azhar comes forward and works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and  angling in on off, Azam defends it down with his bat and pad together.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ali is opened up a bit in his stance but still manages to keep it out towards the point fielder.
Fuller and sprayed on the pads, flicked through backward square leg for a couple.
Babar prods forward and defends it gently off the front foot.
Good length delivery, angling in from outside off, Azam covers the sticks before letting it pass.
Bangs in a short ball on off, it keeps coming in with the angle, Azam drops his wrists to sway away from the line.
Floated ball around middle, Ali defends it back to Chase.
Ali goes back and tucks it on the bounce to FSL.

SIX! Good cricket shot, that! Chase floats it up around off, it turns in as Azhar Ali comes down the track and goes with the turn. Makes good connection as the ball dashes into the rope at long on for a biggie.
Fuller around middle, Ali stays back and keeps it out.
Quicker one around middle, turned towards short leg.
Tossed up outside off, Ali works it towards mid on.
Fuller and angling in on middle, flicked wide of mid on for a single.

FOUR! Lucky Ali! Holder strays one down the leg side, Ali looks to move across and flick it off his hips. He gets an edge which flies past a diving Dowrich towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. Shane dives full length to his left and wasn't that far away. An escape for Azhar.
On a length and keeps it closer to the off stump line, AA leaves it alone.
Good length on off, shapes away a bit as Azhar defends it into the off side.
Good length ball on off, Azhar offers a solid defense.
Fuller in length and angling in, Ali mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Around middle, turns down the leg side as Azam leaves it alone. A successful over from Roston!
Full and around off, spins in as Azam flicks it past the man at short leg.

With the visitors winning the first game and then West Indies clinching the second, the series is levelled and the stage is set. In a way, the perfect encounter for a farewell game. That alone should be motivation enough for the the young blood from the sub-continent to give their heroes a fitting sendoff. Will they succeed in doing so? Or will Jason Holder's men ruin the party? There is some forecast for rain but we hope it does not play spoilsport. Hello and welcome, fellow cricket enthusiasts, for the 3-match series decider at Windsor Park. We're going to bring you all the coverage from this.

It's going to be a rather emotional time five days from now. Obviously for the Pakistan supporters, but also for the neutral cricketing lovers as well. Pretty soon it'll be time to bid farewell to two of the most loyal servants Pakistan have had, Misbah-ul-Haq and Younis Khan. The term legend is thrown around quite loosely, but these two have earned that title in every manner. The veteran pair retire from international cricket after this game after contributing numerous years to Pakistan cricket's success.
